messages:
marie: Heads-up — product needs a clear grandfathering + exception flow for model retirements. Customer asks piling up, legal wants contract language, and eng wants clear launch gates. Can we sketch a pragmatic default?

dez: +1. We need concrete metrics for the gates (perf, cost, quality). Also ops concerns about dual-serving overhead if we keep older variants around.

rafa: Suggested baseline: 90-day notice + 6-month customer opt-in window for critical customers. Gate criteria for removing old model:
- perf: p95 latency for new model <= old p95 + 10%
- quality: avg embedding cosine delta <= 2.5% on canonical eval set
- cost: unit token cost <= old cost * 0.9 (or business ok)

sam: For customer migrations, we should offer a migration bundle: free 3-month pin, dedicated SLA for migration weeks, and a runbook. Customers love a one-click fallback.

marie: That aligns. Need the runbook + a short contract clause template. Tanya — can CS/Legal draft the external wording?

tanya: I can draft a lightweight clause: "customers may request a pin extension up to N months for covered models; Redwood will provide migration assistance and optional fallbacks." Will circulate. Also need to enumerate "covered models" criteria.

dez: Technical objection: keeping both models live increases memory and KV cache complexity. We should cap total pin exceptions per shard or per-cust to avoid OOM. Proposal:

```
max_pinned_per_customer: 3
global_pinned_soft_cap: 200
pin_ttl_default_days: 180
```

ops-bot: NOTE: current infra can support a soft cap of 200 pinned variants before manual scaling recommended.

rafa: Also: require a benchmark bundle for any pin exception. Minimal CI job: run eval set A (50 prompts), embedding drift, and p95 synthetic load at target QPS. If a new model fails any check, deny permanent pin; allow temporary pin for 30 days while engineering mitigates.

sam: UI/Console asks: expose "Request pin extension" with reason + select migration cohort. Add checkboxes: privacy/regulatory, embed-compat, latency-sensitive.

marie: For launch gates on deprecation: we want explicit signals — product signoff, infra OK, legal clause published, CS notified customers flagged as "at-risk". If any fail, deprecation blocked.

dez: Can we make automatic rollback policy if errors > 0.5% in first 24h after cutover? i.e., monitor user-facing error rate and revert to old variant.

rafa: We should also add a regression alert tied to quality evals: if sampling of live outputs shows >3% regression vs baseline on signal prompts, auto-fail and trigger canary rollback.

marie: Action items:
- Tanya: draft contract language and "covered models" criteria (ETA 2d)
- Dez: spec infra limits and pin TTL defaults + autoscaling flags (ETA 3d)
- Rafa: write benchmark CI template + eval thresholds (ETA 3d)
- Sam: product copy & console flow mock for pin requests and migration bundles (ETA 5d)

sam: FYI — flagged customer ACME Corp (ticket #SR-4832) asked for 12-month pin. We should prepare a negotiation playbook: tradeoffs (higher unit cost, no SLAs on pinned old models).

tanya: Noted. Will include negotiation bullets: "cost uplift; reduced feature velocity on pinned model; support windows".

dez: One more thing — implement an expiry reminder sequence: 60d, 30d, 14d, 7d, 1d before pin TTL expires. And a one-click migrate action in the console.

marie: Love it. I'll compile this into a roadmap ticket and add to next sprint for implementation planning. If anyone has objections to the gating numbers, call them out now. Otherwise I'll draft the ticket. :memo:

rafa: No objections from ML. Will comment on the ticket with CI templates.

sam: No objections. Will start mockups.

dez: Fine from infra side with caps noted.

tanya: Ok from CS/legal (will share wording).

ops-bot: Reminder: created ticket RW-PL-7392 to track this initiative and assigned to @marie.
